company.description: Torpedo Therapeutics is building implantable electronic devices for reading and writing to the brain. Using nanotechnology approaches, the company creates minimally invasive electrodes that can be implanted in a variety of different brain regions, including those deep inside the brain, that can record from and stimulate individual neurons and groups of neurons in neural circuits.

aiResearchSummary.text: Torpedo Therapeutics is engaged in developing systems and methods for deep brain stimulation, as described in the title 'Adaptive closed-loop DBS stimulation control.' Their work involves a neural probe designed for brain placement, signal leads, and a sensing assembly with micro-electrodes, focusing on adaptive closed-loop control for neurological disease treatment. These efforts highlight research and development in implantable electronic devices for neurological applications.
